info.description: This API allows users to retrieve information about insurance options associated with car rental reservations. It provides access to various insurance types, coverage details, and pricing options, facilitating informed decision-making for customers. Travel agencies, car rental companies, and customers planning their trips can utilize this service to enhance their rental experience. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline the reservation process and ensure that travelers are adequately covered during their rental period.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed insurance information tied to specific reservations. It provides insights into coverage, policies, and relevant terms for the reservations.
